detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Build a Powerful Lumber Empire

Unlock and expand a growing lineup of unique buildings, each adding new attacks, upgrades, and ways to harvest the forest faster.

Massive Physics-Driven Log Piles

Watch thousands of logs crash, stack, and spill into enormous piles as your operation scales out of control.

Collectors Keep Things Moving

Your workers haul logs across the valley, turning every fallen tree into income and fueling the next stage of growth.

Build. Upgrade. Grow Stronger.

  • 17 buildings to build and upgrade

  • 80+ permanent Prestige upgrades

  • 100+ level-up options to customize each run

  • Powerful active abilities

  • Random events that shake up your runs

  • Multiple projectile tiers that dramatically increase your firepower

  • Watch your encampment grow from a handful of buildings into complete projectile chaos
